description: The acceptance of a release: each ask id of a tracker that the release passes, with the tests that prove it. `cargo todo acceptance --json` writes it from `TODO/ACCEPTANCE.md` (crates/pod-todo/src/acceptance.rs); `release-index.v1` names it in `acceptance`.

asks.description: The asks that the release passes, in the order of the registry.

ask.description: The ask id of its tracker, as `A-X-14` or `G-10`.

tests.description: Each test of the ask: `PATH::NAME` (a test function of the file PATH of the repository) or `PATH` (a script or a workflow that CI runs).

title: The acceptance of a release of a product of PodUtils
